name: Cranberry Raspberry Relish
notes: May be refrigerated, covered for 1 month. Excellent with turkey or ham, including on sandwich rolls in the days following.

items: 2 tart green apples, peeled, cored and finely diced
1 × 10 ounce package frozen raspberries, thawed and drained
1 tsp lemon juice, or to taste

steps.title: Mix the relish
steps.body: Mix in a large bowl: **1 lb fresh cranberries**, finely chopped, **2 tart green apples**, peeled, cored and finely diced, **1 cup sugar**, **½ cup orange marmalade**, **1 × 10 ounce package frozen raspberries**, thawed and drained, and **1 tsp lemon juice** or to taste.
